name: Kanban Board
description:
Cards in status lanes that users drag to a new lane or position, saved with your own PL/SQL.

Source: any region source with one row per card. Map ID, Title and Status; Description, Assignee, Due Date, Label and Color are optional. Cards appear in each lane in the order of the query. Lanes: listed in Columns as value:Label or value:Label:limit (work-in-progress limit), or one per status found in the data. Moving: drag with mouse or touch, or press Ctrl+Left / Ctrl+Right on a focused card. The Move Code gets :ID, :STATUS, :POSITION and :ORDER; if it fails the card moves back.

Live demo: sign in as demo with the password Demo.

Requires Oracle APEX 26.2 or later. Documentation, updates and more plug-ins: https://www.techrevx.com
